name: com.dyvoid.feathertween
description: A robust, minimal C# tween engine for Unity. Compositional sequences, static-method API, struct handles, PlayerLoop runner.

samples.description: A guided tour of FeatherTween as one scrubbable timeline: captioned chapters covering eases, creation modes, loops and delays, sequence composition, runtime control, and typed shortcuts, driven by a player panel with a seek bar, chapter jumps, play/pause, reverse, and speed controls.
